name: VelvetGate – A Luxury-Style Age Gate
author: Pluginable

sections.description:
VelvetGate is a luxury-style age verification plugin for WordPress that restricts access to your website using a beautiful, luxury-inspired full-screen age gate.

It requires visitors to enter their date of birth before accessing content, making it ideal for websites that require age restrictions or compliance-based access control.

Unlike basic age popups, VelvetGate focuses on design quality, user experience, and full visual customization.

Key Features

  • Birthday-based age verification system
  • Minimum age requirement (default 18+)
  • Cookie-based “Remember Me” functionality
  • Fully customizable luxury UI design
  • Custom logo and branding support
  • Custom colors (background, accent, text)
  • Custom redirect URL for underage users
  • Page/post exclusion support
  • Custom CSS support for advanced styling
  • Lightweight and performance optimized

Use Cases

  • Adult content websites
  • Alcohol or vape-related websites (where legally allowed)
  • Membership-based restricted content
  • Premium private communities
  • Any site requiring age verification compliance

Settings

After activation, configure VelvetGate from:

Settings → VelvetGate – Age Gate

You can control:
* Minimum age
* Cookie duration
* Branding and layout
* Colors and typography
* Redirect behavior
* Excluded pages
* Custom CSS

Privacy Policy

VelvetGate uses a browser cookie (velvetgate_verified) to store age verification status. No personal data is collected, stored, or transmitted to external servers.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/velvetgate
  2. Activate the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen
  3. Go to Settings → VelvetGate – Age Gate
  4. Configure your age gate settings
sections.faq:
Does this plugin block the entire site?

Yes, unless specific pages are excluded in the settings.

Can I change the minimum age?

Yes, you can set any minimum age from the admin settings.

Does it store personal data?

No personal data is stored. Only a cookie is used to remember verified users.

Can I customize the design?

Yes, you can fully customize colors, text, logo, and add custom CSS.

Does it work with caching plugins?

Yes, but you may need to exclude the verification cookie from caching rules.
